title: oldenlandia echinulosa var. pellucida

This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
